Definition: from G5210; yours, i.e. pertaining to you:--your (own).
BiblicalUsage: hyméteros is the word for yours, your own. In Luke 6:20, the text says "for your's is the kingdom of God."
TheologicalSignificance: In hyméteros I find no hidden theology; it simply means yours, your own.
RelatedTopics: Word of God; Faith; Christian Life
